Implementation Plan

Planning context interpreted:
- Clarification mapping: no Q1/Q2 were asked; `/answer [auto-answered-by-orchestrator]` indicates continuation without extra constraints.
- Ref context: `HEAD=daa383987ad80d6f3c38457cb55fc474246836a1`, checked out on `orchestrator/project-1479`, integration metadata is `orchestrator/project-1479`, mismatch is `false`.

Conflict detection:
- The issue requires using `set_issue_phase_label_resilient` from `scripts/label_helpers.sh`, but that function is currently not present in this branch (nor in the checked-in support copy), while workflows still contain manual `_AI_PHASE_LABELS` + GET/PUT/POST blocks.
- `review_autofix.yml` has multiple fallback PR refetch callsites (more than one phase-transition block); plan scope includes all fallback issue-number extraction paths to satisfy “fetch only when payload missing.”

Implementation checklist:
- [ ] Add shared resilient phase-label transition helper in `scripts/label_helpers.sh`.
- [ ] Migrate `issue_pr_status.yml` manual phase-label mutation block to helper.
- [ ] Migrate all `review_autofix.yml` manual phase-label mutation callsites to helper.
- [ ] Rework fallback issue-number parsing to use already-available PR title/body first; call PR API only when missing.
- [ ] Add/adjust contract tests for helper adoption and fallback fetch gating.

1. Files likely to change
- `.github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml`
- `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml`
- `scripts/label_helpers.sh`
- `tests/test_ai_label_precreation_contract.py` (extend contract checks)
- `tests/test_phase_label_transition_and_fallback_contract.py` (new targeted contract test, if preferred over expanding existing one)

2. Functions/modules to implement
- `scripts/label_helpers.sh`: add `set_issue_phase_label_resilient <issue_number> <target_label> <repo>`; mirror existing resilient semantics from representative implementation `scripts/review_rb_judge.sh::_resilient_phase_swap` (GET labels -> PUT swap phase labels + target -> POST add fallback, with warning logs and fail-open behavior).
- `issue_pr_status.yml` step “Update linked issues…”: replace inline `_AI_PHASE_LABELS`/PUT logic with `set_issue_phase_label_resilient`.
- `review_autofix.yml` callsites:
  - `ai:ready-to-merge` transition block
  - `ai:review-blocked` transition on autofix exhaustion
  - `ai:review-blocked` transition on workflow failure
  Replace each inline `_AI_PHASE_LABELS`/PUT logic with helper invocation.

3. Data structures affected
- Phase-label set currently duplicated as inline `_AI_PHASE_LABELS` JSON string in workflows will become centralized in `label_helpers.sh`.
- Fallback parsing input source will change from unconditional PR refetch to precedence chain:
  - existing event/input/payload title+body
  - PR API fetch only if those are empty/unavailable

4. API/interface changes
- No external interface changes (no label/env var/log-key renames).
- Internal behavior change: fewer avoidable `GET /repos/{repo}/pulls/{pr}` calls in fallback paths; same non-fallback happy path.
- Keep warning/fail-open semantics equivalent (GET/PUT failures warn and continue with POST add fallback).

5. Risks and edge cases
- `workflow_dispatch` paths may lack `github.event.pull_request.*`; must keep API fetch fallback for that case.
- Empty PR title/body must still allow branch-name fallback and graceful “no linked issues” exit.
- Helper return codes under `set -e` must not abort loops; callsites should keep explicit fail-open handling.
- Preserve existing warning semantics text pattern as much as possible to avoid downstream log-analysis drift.

6. Testing considerations
- Contract assertions:
  - migrated callsites contain `set_issue_phase_label_resilient` and no local `_AI_PHASE_LABELS` mutation blocks.
  - fallback issue-number parsing uses payload/event title/body first and only refetches PR when missing.
  - fail-open paths still present (warning + POST fallback).
- Update/extend `tests/test_ai_label_precreation_contract.py` for workflow contract patterns.
- Add a focused workflow-text contract test for fallback fetch gating in both workflows.
- Run targeted tests plus CI suite gates that already validate workflow contract files.
